description: This source file defines Orleans grains related to implicit stream subscription counting, including a base grain class and derived grain classes with specific subscription behaviors.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing implicit stream subscription to track event and error counts, with state management and stream event handling.

classes.name: FastImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain
classes.description: A derived grain class with specific implicit subscription to 'FastSlowImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain' stream identifier.

classes.name: SlowImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain
classes.description: A derived grain class that delays activation, also subscribing to 'FastSlowImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain' stream identifier, with potential deactivation on events.

classes.name: MyState
classes.description: Serializable inner class representing the persistent state of the grain, tracking counters and stream token.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon activation; the base implementation logs activation and optionally delays for slow activation.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon deactivation; logs deactivation reason.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles stream subscription; sets up handlers for OnNext, OnError, and OnCompleted events.

methods.name: DeactivateOnEvent
methods.description: Sets whether the grain should deactivate automatically upon receiving an event.
